findings.note:
ONE design for all six. Print gates every surki Evolution behind Grand Metamorphosis (Feat 9: 'One of your nodes has adapted into a new magic-emitting organ. You gain one of the evolutions from your surki heritage'); the word 'Evolution' does not appear in the surki ancestry at all. So each heritage's evolution grant is DELETED from the record and re-hung on the matching option of feats/grand-metamorphosis.

DESIGN DEVIATION, flagged deliberately: the orchestrator asked for the choice to be CONVERTED into effectChoices. I kept the existing `choice` (flag 'surkiEvolution', kind 'array') and added `grant` + `requiresAnyFeature` to its options instead. Three reasons, all measured: (a) a FEAT's choice-option grant is already applied through the same applyAlwaysOn sink an effectChoices option uses — build.ts:5588-5598 — so no reader is lost; (b) EffectChoice options have NO per-record gate (only onlyWhenFlag and requiresAnySense; requiresFeature gates the whole question and resolves class features only), while a FeatChoiceDef option's requiresAnyFeature DOES resolve heritage ids since batch 26 (derive.ts narrowChoiceOptions ~1610), which is the only way to honour 'from YOUR surki heritage' — an effectChoices version would offer a breaker surki all eight evolutions; (c) keeping `choice` keeps the 'surkiEvolution' flag semantics literally rather than by imitation. Grep of src/ for 'surkiEvolution' returns NOTHING — no reader existed; its only occurrence was scripts/data/effect-backfill.json:67959, this same choice row. So nothing depended on the old shape.

Engine reader: EffectGrant.grantsActions and its reader have ALREADY LANDED (build.ts:5498-5501, applyAlwaysOn, whose comment cites Grand Metamorphosis by name), so these rows are live on arrival.

Per-option payloads: breaker-spikes -> Trench Digging; elytron-wings -> fly 1/day with traditionFromChoiceFlag 'magiphageTradition' (the ancestry's Magiphage clause: 'it changes the tradition of all surki spells and magical actions to that tradition' — this is elytron-surki#fly-tradition, and the bare grant fell back to the spell's first tradition, arcane, at build.ts:7255); elytron-membranes -> Stridulating Song; hardshell-field -> Dampening Harmonics; lantern-lens -> Lantern Beam; lantern-strobe -> Lantern Strobe (also ungated by print and granted by nothing today). breaker-wedge carries NO grant: the wedge is a stance-like mode (claw to 1d6, +magical/razing/versatile force, -agile) that engine agent 2 builds in modes.ts, which is code and needs no record row — the option's value plus the surkiEvolution flag IS the gate. hardshell-network carries no grant either: the reinforcing-network reaction has no actions record on our side and WG ships it as injectText prose too (see DATA STILL NEEDED).

Both deleted heritage fields SUPERSEDE existing effect-backfill rows. elytron-surki keeps immunities:['falling damage'] — that is its actual 1st-level benefit.
